description: Na₃Mg₂(WO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one WO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.64 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with six WO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.32 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-65°. There are two shorter (1.88 Å) and two longer (1.91 Å) W-O bond lengths. In the second W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-64°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.85 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Mg and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one W atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgW trigonal pyramids.
